info.title: PRKS API — Processing queue slice
info.description: Vertical-slice OpenAPI for the Processing queue (§11.5), served by the PostgreSQL runtime. Schemas are generated from backend/api_contract.

get.summary: One page of the queue: ready items, oldest upload first

400.description: A limit out of range or a malformed cursor (VALIDATION_ERROR).

post.summary: Upload one PDF into the queue
post.description: The body is the PDF. A used `Idempotency-Key` answers with its item without reading the body. Any answer sent before the whole body was read carries `Connection: close`. Duplicates by content are a warning only.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Minted by the client per file: 1-128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`.

parameters.name: PRKS-Filename
parameters.description: The original filename, percent-encoded UTF-8; display only.

200.description: The key was used: its item.

400.description: A bad Idempotency-Key, filename or Content-Length (VALIDATION_ERROR), or a body shorter than Content-Length (PROCESSING_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE).

408.description: The body stalled for 30 seconds, or did not arrive within 60 seconds plus its length at 256 KiB/s (PROCESSING_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT).

415.description: Not sent as application/pdf (unsupported_media_type), or the body does not start with %PDF- (PROCESSING_NOT_A_PDF).

get.summary: An item, or the marker an import or delete left

404.description: No such item in this Library (ENTITY_NOT_FOUND).

patch.summary: Edit a ready item's draft at its revision

400.description: No or a bad revision, or a refused draft value, folder, person, tag or role type (VALIDATION_ERROR).

404.description: No such item in this Library (ENTITY_NOT_FOUND).

409.description: A stale revision (REVISION_CONFLICT), or a marker (PROCESSING_ITEM_IMPORTED, PROCESSING_ITEM_DELETED); `item` is the item as it now is.

delete.summary: Remove a ready item; deleting it again changes nothing

404.description: No such item in this Library (ENTITY_NOT_FOUND).

get.summary: A ready item's PDF as uploaded, with Range support (also HEAD)

404.description: No ready item with that id (ENTITY_NOT_FOUND).

416.description: The range is outside the file.

post.summary: Turn a ready item into a Work, in one transaction
post.description: A retry of a finished import answers with the same Work and creates nothing.

404.description: No such item in this Library (ENTITY_NOT_FOUND).

409.description: A deleted item (PROCESSING_ITEM_DELETED), an imported item whose Work was deleted (IMPORTED_WORK_DELETED), or missing bytes (PROCESSING_OBJECT_MISSING).

post.summary: Import several items, each in its own transaction
post.description: One item's failure never affects another's: each has its own result.

200.description: A result per item, in order.

400.description: item_ids missing, empty, not strings, or more than 500 (VALIDATION_ERROR).

ProcessingFileRole.description: A staged person role, in inbox order.
ProcessingFileRole.title: ProcessingFileRole

ProcessingItemDraft.description: The Work a ``ready`` item will become, as the user drafts it.
ProcessingItemDraft.title: ProcessingItemDraft

ProcessingItem.description: One queue item: a ``ready`` item with its draft, or an ``imported`` or ``deleted`` marker.

ProcessingItemPage.description: GET /api/processing-items: one page of ``ready`` items, oldest upload first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

ProcessingDuplicates.description:
Other ``ready`` items and Works of this Library with the same bytes: a warning only.

Each list names at most ten (items oldest first, Works by id); ``more_*``
says whether there are more.
ProcessingDuplicates.title: ProcessingDuplicates

ProcessingItemUploaded.description: POST /api/processing-items: the item (201 created, 200 for a used Idempotency-Key).

ProcessingFileRoleInput.description:
A staged role as the endpoint accepts it.

An item without a person or role type is skipped. A duplicate
person/role pair keeps its first position.
ProcessingFileRoleInput.title: ProcessingFileRoleInput

ProcessingFileTagInput.description: A staged tag as the endpoint accepts it. ``tag_id`` is read when ``id`` is empty.
ProcessingFileTagInput.title: ProcessingFileTagInput

ProcessingItemUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /api/processing-items/{id}. ``revision`` is required; omit a field to leave it unchanged.

Draft values are stringified and trimmed. ``thumb_page`` keeps a whole
page number of at least 1 and clears anything else. An empty
``target_folder_id`` clears it. ``roles`` and ``tags`` replace the
drafted list; ``null`` leaves it unchanged.

revision.description: The item's revision the edit was made against.
revision.title: Revision

ProcessingItemImported.description: POST /api/processing-items/{id}/import: the Work (201 created, 200 for an import already done).

ProcessingImportRequest.description: POST /api/processing-items/import: the items to import, each in its own transaction, in order.

ProcessingImportResult.description: One item's outcome: ``work_id`` when it imported, else ``code`` (and ``item`` when there is one).
ProcessingImportResult.title: ProcessingImportResult

ProcessingItemRefusal.description:
Every refusal on these routes.

The queue's own refusals and admission's authorization refusals carry
``code`` and ``message`` (and ``item``, as it now is, when there is
one). Refusals decided before admission or the route (Host, Origin, the
JSON body reader, an unavailable database) carry ``error`` alone.
